facts.fact: The South African Revenue Service issued RFI 03/2025 on 20 June 2025 seeking vendors for an AI-driven digital twinning (cognitive decision automation) solution to automate a high-volume tax administration decision process, stating it is a market engagement exercise, not a formal procurement, that may lead to a proof of concept.
facts.system: RFI 03/2025 AI-Driven Digital Twinning (Cognitive Decision Automation) Solution
